children: PodcastOne's interim chief financial officer, Craig Christensen, is leaving the company to pursue another opportunity.
Christensen, who also serves as interim treasurer and secretary and acting principal accounting officer, informed the company of his exit on Monday. His departure was effective Friday.
His exit didn't result from a dispute with the company, it said in a Friday filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company has launched a search for his successor.
